title_en: Save Over 50% Off One of the Coolest Desktop Charging Stations I've Ever Seen, Includes Both AC Outlets and 140W USB-C Ports
summary_en: Features three AC outlets and four USB-C ports with up to 240W of maximum power output.
body_en:
Tired of the same old black or white power strip? If you're looking for something with no lack of style, then check out this head turner from Mfish. For a limited time, Amazon is offering Amazon Prime members the Mfish E-Tank 240W Desktop Charging Station for $68.17 with free shipping after coupon code " SGH3OZJY ", a 52% drop from its $140 list price. I actually own one myself. It's really well built and is definitely the coolest looking power strip I've seen personally.
The Mfish E-Rhino power station deserves to sit on top of your desk in plain site. It features a two tone black and silver colorway with three illuminated ringed power outlets. The lights can be rotated through seven different colors and ten different modes. They also aren't distractingly bright. The power strip itself is pretty compact, measuring 7.7" x 2.8" x 3.4", but it weighs over two pounds so that it will stay in place.
Total outputs include three standard 3-prong AC outlets rated for up to 1,250W each and four USB-C ports with 240W maximum power output (140W max for a single port). The cord is five feet long and features a slim right angle plug so you can fit it discreetly behind your desk.
Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.
